description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing document folders and files in the vtiger CRM system, including folder creation, deletion, renaming, moving files, and checking file integrity.

methods.name: UpdateAjaxSave
methods.description: Saves updates to a document or folder via AJAX, with validation and UI feedback.

methods.name: closeFolderCreate
methods.description: Closes the folder creation dialog and resets input fields.

methods.name: AddFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder with validation and updates the folder list.

methods.name: DeleteFolderCheck
methods.description: Checks if a folder can be deleted, prompts user confirmation.

methods.name: DeleteFolder
methods.description: Deletes a folder via AJAX and updates the UI.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves selected files to a specified folder with confirmation and mass operation handling.

methods.name: dldCntIncrease
methods.description: Increments download count for a file via AJAX.

methods.name: checkFileIntegrityDetailView
methods.description: Checks file integrity and displays result messages.

methods.name: hideresult
methods.description: Hides the file integrity result message.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Adds a relation between entities in the CRM system.
